product_one_liner.value: Hover turns smartphone property scans into measured 3D models and tools for design, estimating, and proposals for construction and insurance professionals and homeowners.

eng_blog.notes: The public blog contains product updates and contractor/home-improvement content; two qualifying engineer-authored how-built posts were not found.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The live job board lists Senior Engineering Manager, Computer Vision; Senior Director, Engineering – AI Renovation; and Technical Operations Lead, Computer Vision.

model_provider.value: In-house/self-hosted ML models, including models Hover has built or fine-tuned.
model_provider.notes: Hover explicitly says it self-hosts models it has built or fine-tuned; no external production model provider is established by this statement.

compliance_certs.notes: Hover describes maintaining SOC 2 compliance; the cited directory reports its public SOC 2 claim. This is a public claim, not independent verification of the audit report. GDPR is addressed in the DPA as a legal obligation, not a certification.

last_funding.notes: The funding history records a completed $3.6 million debt financing on February 19, 2026. This is newer than the November 2020 Series D equity round.

raised_18mo.notes: The dated financing history records debt funding on February 19, 2026, within May 9, 2025–November 9, 2026. Evidence is a funding-database deal entry rather than a company announcement.

launched_6mo.notes: October 2026 v2.0.0 introduced multi-structure support in the Salesforce integration, including separate models, measurements, and estimates for each structure; this is a substantial feature release inside the six-month window.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: Sam Young joined as VP of Operations in March 2026; his dated March 2 announcement confirms the join.

crm_stack_signal.notes: The sales-development management posting names Salesforce and Gong, and Salesforce plus Outreach or similar sequencing tools. These are visible stack signals, not an exhaustive verified software inventory.
